messages.text: I'm right here and listening, Hemanth! What can I help you with?
close all the tabs other than brave

Sure, I'll help with that. Are you currently on your laptop or using a different device? If it's your laptop, you can close all tabs except Brave by running this command in your terminal:

```bash
for tab in $(pgrep -f "brave"); do if [[ $(ps -o comm -p $tab) != "brave" ]]; then kill -9 $tab; fi; done
```

This script finds all processes related to Brave and kills the ones that aren't the Brave browser itself. If you're on a different device, let me know the operating system and any specific instructions you need! 🚀
